content.short: iVendPay is a global crypto payment system that enables TON payments for physical and online merchants.
content.description: iVendPay is a comprehensive multi-currency payment system that bridges the gap between digital assets and traditional commerce. It allows merchants, both online and in physical locations, to accept TON and other cryptocurrencies as payment through POS terminals, e-commerce plugins, and mobile apps. iVendPay's robust infrastructure ensures secure and fast transaction processing, making it easier than ever for users to spend their Toncoin in everyday scenarios and for businesses to adopt the benefits of blockchain-based payments globally.
content.meta: Spend TON anywhere with iVendPay's global payment system. Discover merchant tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
